parsed.internal_thinking: I am holding a Monopoly card. My goal is to settle node 31, which requires Wood and Brick. I have Sheep, Ore, and Wheat. Claude has 3 Wood and 2 Wheat. Gemma has 2 Wood and 1 Sheep. Since no one has Brick (confirmed by my failed trade and game state analysis), calling Monopoly on Brick is useless. However, calling it on Wood will give me at least 5 Wood (3 from Claude, 2 from Gemma). I can then use the 4:1 bank trade to get the Brick I need and still have enough Wood to build the settlement. This maximizes my current hand and secures the strategic location at N31.
parsed.note_to_self: Used Monopoly for Wood. Plan to bank trade for Brick and settle N31. Claude is now resource-poor in Wood.
